capabilities: display the Sakana! widget while writing notes
add your own custom widget in settings
disambiguation: Not a productivity or status tool; it is a decorative animated widget for fun.
extras: Not yet available in the official community plugin market; can be installed via BRAT or manually from releases.
intentEvidence: Add the Sakana! Widget to your own Obsidian! You can play with it when you are writing notes.
motivation: The README frames it as adding the Sakana! Widget to your own Obsidian so you can play with it while writing notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show a fun interactive widget or companion character in the workspace.
summary: Widget plugin that displays an animated Sakana! character in Obsidian that you can play with while writing notes.
